data.desc: Lincoln Financial helps people confidently plan for their vision of a successful financial future. As of December 31, 2025 , approximately 17 million customers trust our guidance and solutions across four core businesses - annuities, life insurance, group protection, and retirement plan services. As of June 30, 2026 , the Company had $366 billion in end-of-period account balances, net of reinsurance. Headquartered in Radnor, PA , Lincoln Financial is the marketing name for Lincoln National Corporation (NYSE: LNC) and its affiliates.
